integrity: The source multiplication is reconstructed using its defining cocycle equation, with independent exact proof of normal forms, scalar fibers, isomorphism separation, automorphism stabilizers and form/product orbit arithmetic. Finite-field enumeration is replay evidence, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate symmetric-cocycle-induced anti-pre-Lie structures on the fixed two-dimensional affine Lie algebra are classified.
The complex-field two-type classification already appears in the original 2022 paper.
General arbitrary-field low-dimensional nonassociative algebra classifications may encode the same normal forms; full text of Petersson (2000) was inaccessible.
title: Square-class descent for cocycle-induced anti-pre-Lie algebras on the affine line
